messages:
marco (CS): hi team — raised by enterprise account 789-az. customer tried to apply two vouchers (WELCOME2025 and RESELLER50) and says the second one replaced the first instead of stacking. they lost the WELCOME credits. can we confirm behavior and get a restore?

sam (Support): sorry to hear that. can you drop the exact steps the customer took? did they use the dashboard or the API? any request IDs / timestamps?

marco (CS): they first applied WELCOME2025 in the web billing UI on 2026-02-11 ~09:42 UTC. then a partner rep applied RESELLER50 via the admin API at 10:05 UTC. customer reports their available credit decreased (WELCOME amount gone) and only RESELLER50 remains. they captured the API call:

```
POST /admin/v1/accounts/789-az/promos/apply
Authorization: Bearer <secret>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "code": "RESELLER50",
  "applier": "partner-integration",
  "idempotency_key": "req-20260211-100501"
}
```

and the response: 
```
{ "status": "ok", "applied": { "code": "RESELLER50", "credit": 5000 }, "overwritten": ["WELCOME2025"] }
```

sam (Support): yikes. tagging @mike for billing logic. @jessica FYI in case this is runtime race/legacy behavior.

mike (Billing): thanks @sam. quick summary of current system: we historically stored a single active_promo_id on account_billing. newer accounts and the fresh stacking feature support multiple active promo rows (account_promotions table). if account was created before stacking rollout and hasn't run the migration, the admin API path that applies promo falls back to 'set active_promo_id = coupon.id' semantics — last write wins. looks like partner used admin API path that still triggers overwrite. :grimacing:

jessica (Eng): adding detail — there's also an idempotency check, but it only guards duplicate apply attempts for the same code. the apply handler has two code paths: dashboard flow (creates account_promotion row) and admin/apply flow (updates active_promo_id). we intentionally didn't migrate every org to avoid surprise billing deltas early.

mike (Billing): mitigation options:
- immediate: manually credit the delta for the customer (we can grant the missing WELCOME2025 credit amount back).
- short-term: re-run migration for this org so both promos can coexist.
- long-term: change admin API to create account_promotions rows instead of updating active_promo_id.

sam (Support): marco — can you confirm the WELCOME2025 nominal credit amount so we can restore? also we should ask partner to stop using the admin apply endpoint until we fix it.

marco (CS): WELCOME2025 was for 7500 token units. customer is happy to accept manual restore while engineering changes the endpoint. partner says they were following docs for "admin apply" in the integration guide.

billing-bot: escalation created: INC-4552. Priority: P2. Assigned to: billing-team. Notes: legacy-active_promo overwrite observed; manual credit requested.

jessica (Eng): plan: i can push a narrow change to admin service to use the same create-promotion codepath. patch will:
- create account_promotion row if not present
- preserve existing promos (no deletion)
- add a feature-flag so we can flip on after smoke tests
expected timeline: patch + canary in 48h, full rollout 72h after validation.

mike (Billing): i've scheduled a manual credit job for account 789-az for 7500 tokens. will mark as 'promo-restore' and attach INC-4552.

sam (Support): thanks everyone. marco pls confirm with customer that we've queued the restore and asked partner to pause admin apply calls. i'll keep this thread open until jessica's canary completes. :thumbsup:

marco (CS): confirmed with customer. partner paused. customer appreciated quick turnaround.

jessica (Eng): once canary passes i'll post the rollout dashboard link and the PR. keep INC-4552 updated.

sam (Support): closing loop — restore executed at 2026-02-11T11:10:30Z (server). customer balance shows both promos now (WELCOME2025 + RESELLER50). leaving this as resolved but will follow up on admin-api change. :white_check_mark:
